# Urban Plant Tracker (urbanplanttracker.com)

> Smart indoor plant care companion with automated watering reminders, botanical light logs, and care guides.

Key facts:
- Keep your green friends thriving effortlessly.
- Phone-first web app; add urbanplanttracker.com to your home screen.
